rows.label: Study notes
rows.text: **What it is:** extracting and restating passage information — the trap is copying whole sentences; the skill is locate-then-restate.  ·  **Method:** skim for gist → scan for the question's keywords (the answer lives nearby) → answer in complete sentences with synonyms → match the question type (WH → answer the WH; 'Why' → 'Because…'; true/false → quote evidence) → verify against the text.  ·  **Grammar of answers:** convert passage nouns into clauses ('its existence' → 'that it exists'); use report frames ('the passage states that…'); keep the passage's tense zone; quote marks ONLY when demanded.
